gloss: suddenly, abruptly, out of the blue

definitions.explanation: Describes something happening unexpectedly and without preparation or build-up.

examples.japanese: いきなり{来|き}ないで⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Don't just show up out of nowhere.

examples.japanese: いきなり⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}って→降る：00839_furu⟧きた。
いきなり⟦{怒|おこ}り{出|だ}して→怒り出す：29598_okoridasu⟧⟦びっくりした→びっくりする：01178_bikkurisuru⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised when they suddenly got angry.

examples.japanese: いきなり⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{困|こま}る→困る：00861_komaru⟧。
examples.english: I'm stumped when you suddenly ask something difficult.

notes:
いきなり emphasizes the unexpected, abrupt nature of an action or event. It often implies that something happened without the usual preparation, warning, or gradual lead-up.

Common collocations:
- いきなり⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to show up suddenly
- いきなり⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: to start abruptly
- いきなり⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say out of nowhere

Similar expressions:
- ⟦{突然|とつぜん}→突然：00409_totsuzen⟧: suddenly (more neutral/formal)
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: suddenly (emphasizes speed)
- だしぬけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: unexpectedly, out of the blue
